summary_for_children: Al-Bayyinah means The Clear Evidence. It says people were commanded to worship Allah sincerely, pray and give charity.
environment_concept: A world of clear water and clean pages, showing sincere worship.
architecture_and_scenery: A clear spring and an open book of pure pages.

activities.name: Sincerity
activities.description: Choose actions done only for Allah (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
